verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own feedback flow ties a user report to an intention: an intention starts from the report, and submissions can route to a chosen project. That is a form of linking feedback to planned work, but nothing shows linking feedback to roadmap features, initiatives, or releases as such. Missing for 10: explicit linking of feedback to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases; linking one feedback item to several existing items; any release or roadmap object; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link feedback requests to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases

citations.quote: An intention starts from the report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention, and proposes the tasks
Pick a project on that page and submissions route to that project.
